item.title: GOP whip: ‘America-hating terrorists’ should lose citizenship under SCAM Act
item.summary: A string of recent terrorist attacks reportedly by naturalized citizens exposes serious flaws in U.S. immigration law that can be fixed by the SCAM Act, claims House Majority Whip Tom Emmer, R-Minn.

item.title: Australian prime minister heckled at mosque, called 'putrid dog' by protestors
item.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese faced a hostile reception at Sydney’s Lakemba Mosque as protesters label him a "genocide supporter" over the Gaza conflict.

item.title: 9-year-old dies in viral ‘blackout challenge’ horror as parents demand accountability: 'It's life or death'
item.summary: 9-year-old JackLynn Blackwell died after attempting the viral "blackout challenge," and her father Curtis Blackwell is warning parents about the deadly social media trend.

item.title: Florida man mistaken for Jeffrey Epstein sends internet into frenzy: ‘I’m just me being me’
item.summary: A Florida man known as "Palm Beach Pete" says he was unknowingly filmed on I-95, sparking viral conspiracy theories that Jeffrey Epstein is still alive.

item.title: FBI warns Russian hackers targeting Americans on Signal; thousands of accounts compromised
item.summary: The FBI warned that Russian intelligence-linked hackers are targeting Signal users, including U.S. officials and journalists, compromising thousands of accounts.

item.title: Highway shut down after waste truck carrying dead bird flu ducks crashes in northern Indiana
item.summary: A hazmat situation unfolded in Churubusco, Indiana, after a truck carrying bird flu-infected dead ducks crashed into a ditch on U.S. Route 33, officials say.

item.title: Far-left ex-MSNBC host argues Kamala Harris shouldn't run in 2028, cites Biden policy 'stain'
item.summary: Joy Reid argued Kamala Harris shouldn't run for president again during an interview on Friday, and said the U.S. would never elect a woman president in her lifetime.

item.title: Iran regime could 'fall pretty soon,' Victor Davis Hanson says, as global tide turns
item.summary: Historian Victor Davis Hanson said Iran’s regime could fall within weeks as the U.S. deployed roughly 2,500 Marines amid escalating tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Stephen A Smith stunned after Rep Kevin Kiley educates him on California voter ID ban
item.summary: Stephen A. Smith reacted with surprise after Rep. Kevin Kiley explained California’s voter ID laws and discussed election integrity and the SAVE Act.

item.title: Former MLB outfielder Larry Stahl, best known for spoiling a perfect game, dead at 84
item.summary: Larry Stahl, the former MLB player who drew a controversial walk to spoil Milt Pappas' perfect game in 1972, has died at age 84 in Illinois.
